hints.title: SubStructural Analysis Contribution
hints.text: For each child substructured search, decide whether adding its maximum connected component containing the child improves the score.

hints.title: Post-Order Tree Traversal
hints.text: Compute for each node the maximum score of a connected component anchored at that node.

hints.title: Take Only Positive Children
hints.text: anchored[u] = vals[u] + sum(max(0, anchored[v]) for v in children).

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Visits every node and edge once in a single DFS traversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all 2^n possible node subsets and verifying connectivity is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Adjacency list and recursion stack require O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects Kadane-like dynamic programming on trees using DFS.
